title: Q-AGENT-MERGED-PR: a merged PR authored through the code-agent ladder, with a rising deploy count
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** grep:ops/executor-log.jsonl::"author_path": "ladder"
**Status:** open

Prove the executor on the Workers AI adapters edits the repo end to end: pick issue, agent edits, PR, checks, merge, deploy, dashboard shows it. Probe passes when an executor-log row records the ladder as author and the PR is merged. Filed at thread close; the executor works it in driver order.
